place_fields.summary: A hilltop location in Mandoli associated with open land surrounded by lush nature.
A scenic viewpoint near Khanapur with panoramic views of forests and valleys; the approach can include a short nature trek.
place_fields.best_time: June-September for monsoon greenery; October-February for clearer views

planning_attributes.description: A relatively quiet viewpoint suited to nature viewing, photography and a short trek.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Road access is via the Khanapur/Chigule area; the final approach may include a short nature trek.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Use care on forest trails and changing monsoon conditions.
planning_attributes.notes: Trip.com lists the address as Khanapur, Chigule, Karnataka 591345.

place_fields.summary: A biodiversity park near VTU in Machhe, Belagavi, developed as a large urban green space for biodiversity conservation and recreation.
place_fields.best_time: 10:30 AM-5:30 PM according to published timetable

planning_attributes.description: An ecological park on Jamboti Road near the VTU campus in Machhe.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The park was inaugurated in 2017 and developed under the Nagara Vana Udyan project; contemporary reports describe it as a roughly 300-acre biodiversity park.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The park is on Jamboti Road near VTU, Machhe, Belagavi.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow on-site access and park guidance; published visitor hours should be checked before travel.
planning_attributes.notes: Published sources differ slightly on the park area, so no exact area is asserted here.
